verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk-export or account-exit feature. Square does expose broad programmatic read access to seller data through REST list endpoints with cursor-based pagination, a GraphQL API covering orders, catalog, customers and inventory, and an MCP server with a read-only mode. That lets a user extract their data via API, but only through a self-built workaround. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, explicit open formats such as CSV or JSON dumps, an offboarding or portability workflow, and independent corroboration of complete data extraction.
